As part of the procurement preparation process, we invite potential service providers to participate in a market dialogue. The purpose of the market dialogue is to gain insight into available solutions and market capabilities, discuss the contracting authorities' objectives and requirements, and gather feedback to support the development of a practical, transparent, and competitive procurement process. This market consultation is intended to gather information and feedback from potential service providers to support the preparation of a possible future procurement. Participation is voluntary, does not create any obligations for either party, and is neither a prerequisite or an advantage in any future tender process. The contracting authorities are not obliged to proceed with the procurement or to take into account any views expressed during the consultation. No compensation will be paid for participation and all information provided will be used solely for procurement preparation purposes. BACKGROUND The cities of both Lahti and Kuopio currently operate public bike-sharing systems and are preparing for the next contract periods. Lahti and Kuopio are regional cities of comparable size and have experience in operating similar electrically assisted bike-sharing systems. This provides an opportunity to explore the possibility of joint procurement while enabling the contracting authorities to benefit from shared experience, common requirements, and potential economies of scale. The aim of both cities is to procure a flexible, reliable, and userfriendly bike-sharing service, with the possibility of including the surrounding municipalities of both city regions.
